explanation: Check odd starts in increasing order. A trajectory falling below its start reaches a previously verified case; even starts reduce immediately. A repeated value detects a cycle. BigInt prevents wraparound while following trajectories.
timeComplexity: O(T) arithmetic/set operations for T examined trajectory steps; BigInt costs depend on trajectory magnitude.
spaceComplexity: O(S) stored trajectory values for the longest segment, each using its required BigInt bit length.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
